args.question: What PHQ-9 score bands mean mild, moderate, moderately severe and severe depression?
What does NICE ESF standard 16 require on ongoing usage reporting?

args.text: Since go-live in March 2026, 62 percent of eligible members at Northfield Health activated the program. Members who completed 8 weeks saw PHQ-9 scores fall by an average of 6 points. The program is clinically proven to reduce depression and will cut your behavioral health costs.

Members who completed 8 weeks saw PHQ-9 scores fall by an average of 6 points.
The program is clinically proven to reduce depression and will cut your behavioral health costs.
